definitions.pushed: P1 or P2 (reaches a person in-app or on Slack); P3 is digest-only and not counted
definitions.per_week: pushed alerts / weeks from the window start to the newest development (at least one week)
definitions.per_active_day: pushed alerts / days on which at least one new development was first seen
definitions.per_push_day: pushed alerts / days with at least one push (burst size, never below 1)
definitions.precision: share of labelled pushed alerts whose development label is >= 1 (worth knowing) or == 2 (material); label_0 counts pushes labelled noise
definitions.label2_recall: label-2 developments of the audience (in the window) that got a P1/P2 alert
definitions.holdout: developments first seen on/after the scorer's time-split date (scoring_metrics.json split.test_from)
definitions.lens_dismissed: pushed alerts whose own audience lens says no_action (investment) or hold (ai_team)

alerts.label_note: One label per development: human annotators (majority) when present, else the latest LLM judge. LLM-judge precision is in-sample: `fli train` refits the deployed scorers on all labels after the time-split evaluation (hold-out window included), so treat it as optimistic until human labels exist.

scoring.target: label >= 1 (worth knowing or material); label == 2 reported as roc_auc_material
scoring.label_policy: per development: human labels (majority) preferred over the LLM judge
scoring.split: time-ordered: first 70% by first_seen_at train, rest test

definitions.checked: lenses on live developments whose Lens.checks carry a 'grounded' verdict (written by the lens stage, refreshed by `fli lens-recheck`)
definitions.grounded: no figure in the headline, so-what or a ticker rationale that the lens input does not contain, and no official-wording flag (fli.deliver.lens.faithfulness_checks); a code check of figures and provenance wording, not a semantic entailment judge
definitions.unsupported_numbers: figures (numbers, percentages, multiples, amounts) not written in the lens input, by field; figures in what_to_do are reported but do not make a lens ungrounded
definitions.headlines_replaced: lenses whose model headline stated an unsupported figure or official wording and was replaced by the development title (the original is kept in the checks)
definitions.official_wording: claims worded as official without an official source, or whose figures are not in the official evidence
definitions.tickers_dropped: investment lenses that abstained (no_action) and had their tickers cleared
definitions.pushed: the same counts for the lenses behind a P1/P2 alert of their own audience (the text a person is sent)

definitions.window: documents published (else fetched) and developments first seen on/after settings.backfill_start
definitions.documents: collected documents in the window, duplicates excluded, whose title or text names the company or a brand it owns (the exposure rules' whole-word, case-sensitive names: fli.analyze.exposure.mention_names); documents_relevant passed triage
definitions.developments_event_specific: live developments with an exposure link to the holding that is not lab-level (method != 'lab'); named = the development's own text names the company (the rest are theme-keyword links); at_policy_floor = confidence >= the materiality policy's exposure_min_confidence, i.e. what the alert rules count as exposure
definitions.developments_lab_only: developments linked to the holding only through their lab's curated relations (context, not exposure)
definitions.pushed_alerts: investment P1/P2 alerts whose Tickers line lists the holding (investment is the only audience whose alerts list tickers); pushed_lab_level = listed only as a lab-level link
definitions.coverage: direct: at least one document names it; indirect: none does, but theme-keyword links exist; none: neither

definitions.writer: model: the digest model wrote the sections; fallback: the deterministic renderer (no usable model output; provisional, regenerated on the next run); empty: no item reached the bar that week
definitions.cited: selected items the published report cites anywhere (written sections, 'Also this week', holdings check)
definitions.written: selected items cited by the written sections; the others were appended under 'Also this week'
definitions.model_written: the same over model-written reports; the digest rejects model output citing fewer than min_coverage of the selected items
definitions.flags_missing: items stored without the cited / also_this_week flags (legacy rows), left out of the shares
definitions.missing_weeks: weeks from the backfill start to the last full week without a report
definitions.preview_reports: reports generated before their week ended (regenerated on the next run)

definitions.documents: every collected document, duplicates included, by the document's source class, its source's kind and its lab (the document's, else its source's); relevant = passed triage
definitions.silent_sources: registered sources that never produced a document; reason: disabled, never_run (no run recorded), failing (the last run failed), no_items (ran without collecting anything)
definitions.active_weeks: weeks of the window (backfill start to the newest document) with at least one document
